student_learning_goal: I can sort 5 named solids by faces, edges, and vertices.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can sort 5 named solids by faces, edges, and vertices.
header.character_watermark: Trekker Tig the Tiger Cub in the top-right with a backpack and 3D solid basket. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at 5 solid icons. Write the name under each.
parts.visual_layout: A row of 5 solid icons with a name line under each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 solid identification row for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 5 solid icons in a row: cube, rectangular prism, square pyramid, cylinder, cone. Each with a name line below.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P1_NAMES at Part 1: keywords name the solid icons row for identification.

parts.student_instructions: For 3 solids, count FACES, EDGES, and VERTICES.
parts.visual_layout: A 3-row attribute count chart with three solid icons and three count columns.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 attribute count chart for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 3 rows: cube, square pyramid, cone. 3 columns: Faces, Edges, Vertices. Empty count cells.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P2_COUNTS at Part 2: keywords name the chart count cells for attribute counting.

parts.answer_key: Cube: 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices. Pyramid: 5 faces, 8 edges, 5 vertices. Cone: 2 (or 1 flat + 1 curved), 1 edge, 1 vertex.

parts.student_instructions: Sort 8 mixed solid icons into 5 named piles.
parts.visual_layout: Eight solid icons at the top and five named bins at the bottom for sorting.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 sort grid for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 8 mixed solid icons at top. 5 named bins at bottom: cube, prism, pyramid, cylinder, cone. Lines or arrows to draw.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS01_P3_SORT at Part 3: keywords name the sort grid bins for sorting solids.

parts.answer_key: Each solid placed in the correct named bin.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw 1 NEW solid you can think of and name it.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Diagnostic — check naming and counting accuracy. Part 3 transfer: 3 REAL-WORLD Canadian-context objects (e.g., Tim Hortons cup = cylinder, hockey puck = cylinder, soup can = cylinder; or maple-syrup tin = rectangular prism, etc.). Verifies attribute-based sorting beyond geometric shapes.
